status.description: Outcome status of the onboarding pipeline.

endpoint_url.description: Verified HTTP inference endpoint URL when mode includes inference.

job_id.description: Compute job ID of the inference server; live only in serving mode.

compute_profile.description: The compute profile the inference server runs under; set with job_id when a server is left running.

health_status.description: Last polled health state of the inference server.

unwiring_status.description: Outcome of CUDA unwiring; not_required when preflight flagged nothing.

output_files.description: Named hand-off files produced by the workflow, as fully resolved run-scoped paths.

benchmark_report.description: Path to generated benchmark report markdown.

deployments_json.description: Path to the deployments.json service manifest the server was launched from: model, engine, max_model_len, parallelism and every other serving flag. tpu-agent hands it to tpu-kernel-development as `serving_config`, so a kernel harness is built from the configuration the server actually runs.

launch_recipe.description: Path to the recipe the server was launched with (e.g. launch_vllm.sh): the exact serve command and environment, including flags the manifest does not hold, such as --attention-backend. Handed to tpu-kernel-development with `deployments_json`.

bench_request.description: Path to bench_request.json (schemas/bench-request.json): the serving benchmark's route, the client's exact arguments and the server it measured. Run again against a changed server, it measures the change on the same points.

results_json.description: Path to benchmark results: for a served model, the serving benchmark client's summary.json for `bench_request` (a sweep's merged one).

patches.description: Path to the model_patches.py unwiring module.

sweep_plan.description: Path to the sweep_plan.json a benchmark of several shapes ran from, when it ran on several servers at once. Its merged summary.json is the measurement.

candidate_report.description: report.json comparing a measured serving candidate with the baseline per point (report.py).

artifacts.description: Durable artifact paths produced under the run's artifacts directory.

error.description: Error diagnostic details if status is failed or blocked.

examples.summary: Model successfully benchmarked and deployed on TPU v5e.
